audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-19 OPENER PART TWO - the three table-and-doctrine chains of the issue. CHAIN ONE, the Origins 78 tournament synopsis by Bryan and Kathy Bullinger with the Blake competitive D&D scoring (print 3-4 + 6, PDF 5-6 + 8): the Battle for Snurre Hall walk - the triangular alcove, Obmi the treacherous rescued dwarf, the blade barrier and wall of fire blocks, the haste turning point, the king only pretending and the head in the bag of holding; the Blake victory-point doctrine - the G, R, C terms times the survivor S, the room-plus-clue-equals-giant weighting, the subjectivity-objectivity-combination ladder, the GenCon X and GenCon XI stories and the DM consistency doctrine. CHAIN TWO, Planning Creative Treasures by Dave Schroeder (print 13, PDF 15) and the Charts for Determining the Location of Treasure by Ronald Guritzky (print 25, PDF 27): the sdmLoc, sdmTrap and sdmGas grids - the d20 location chart with the unassigned 14-15 bands, the thirteen-kind percentile trap chart, the sixteen-outcome d6-by-d4 gas chart; the kit and theme doctrine. CHAIN THREE, Spell Determination for Hostile Magic Users by Steve Miller (print 24-25, PDF 26-27): the die-for-level method - the worked 10-spell enchanter with the d20, the conjurer d4, the magician d8 - and the nine contiguous percentile grids sdmDet1 through sdmDet9, 75 rows from Hold Portal through Monster Summoning VII with the reroll doctrine.

banner.title: The Dragon issue-19 opener part two - the Origins 78 tourney and victory-point scoring, the creative treasures and location charts, and the hostile magic-user spell determination: the three-chain round
banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 5 (October 1978), the Curtiss-provided scan voice (single voice: the issue-19 source is the uploaded Dm19.pdf with its mistral-ocr transcript; no archive.org djvu cross-check exists for issue 19). PRINT FOLIO = PDF PAGE MINUS TWO, verified at the page feet in the R937 intake (folios 12, 18, 21, 24, 26 and 31 print at the PDF pages 14, 20, 23, 26, 28 and 33); this round pins print 3-4 + 6 (PDF 5-6 + 8), print 13 + 25 (PDF 15 + 27) and print 24-25 (PDF 26-27).
banner.sentinel: Print quirks pinned AS SCANNED, noted never silent: the scoring formula prints (G=R=C) x S = VP - the pluses for the sum pinned in the audit comment, the formula kept as printed; the Snurre Hall continuation rides the tail of the Ettins article stamped Smurre with an S; the shrine prints Kuo-Tao while the fight paragraph prints Kuo-Toa; the location chart prints 13-13 for the pot then jumps to 16-17 loose, the d20 bands 14-15 never assigned; the assassin kit dagger prints a plus +2 dagger, the doubled plus; the enchanter spell list trails into a printed ellipsis after the 4 first level and 3 second level counts; the second-level table prints -01-05 for Levitate, the leading dash; Hold Portal and Time Stop carry the asterisk that means dungeons only, reroll for wilderness encounters.
